upstreamFrontmatter.name: artifact-publish
upstreamFrontmatter.description: Publish a self-contained HTML or Markdown page to the internal artifact service and get back a link anyone on the company network can open. Use whenever the user asks to publish something, share it as a page or link, make an artifact, show it in a browser, or turn a report, plan, dashboard, demo, diagram, or side-by-side comparison into something viewable. Reach for it on your own when the output would land better as a page than as terminal text, even if the user never says "publish" or "artifact". Also covers updating a page published earlier.
